description: Source code for the FunctionLookup class, used for managing unresolved function calls during parsing in a compiler or shader translator.

classes.name: TFunctionLookup
classes.description: Class for storing and managing function call information, including mangled names and arguments.

methods.name: CreateConstructor
methods.description: Creates a TFunctionLookup instance representing a constructor.

methods.name: CreateFunctionCall
methods.description: Creates a TFunctionLookup instance representing a function call.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the function.

methods.name: getMangledName
methods.description: Returns the mangled name of the function based on its arguments.

methods.name: GetMangledName
methods.description: Generates a mangled name for a function with given arguments.

methods.name: getMangledNamesForImplicitConversions
methods.description: Returns all possible mangled names considering implicit conversions.

methods.name: isConstructor
methods.description: Checks if the function lookup represents a constructor.

methods.name: constructorType
methods.description: Returns the constructor type if applicable.

methods.name: setThisNode
methods.description: Sets the 'this' node for the function call.

methods.name: addArgument
methods.description: Adds an argument to the function call.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol associated with the function call.
